When presence is confirmed, the clock rewinds to make room. Static softens. A message emerges. Carry the gesture beyond this screen: pause, invite, listen, then decide together.

About the experiment + audio controls

This artwork uses p5.js, generative noise, local face detection and your explicit confirmation. It cannot identify gender or tell whether a person is participating in a decision. Camera-free mode is a clearly labelled demonstration.

Audio starts only when enabled. Your optional voice clip stays in this browser session.
